items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: I started, my sister was taking piano lessons.

ctx.x: So how did you get started playing? Me?

That's a long story. I was a child prodigy on the piano. I started, my sister was taking piano lessons. My mother, let me say this, my mother was a very fine pianist and a violinist. And my father was a very good trumpet player, a good cornet player. And there was always music in our house. And I used to like to play the snare drum. I like drums.
